description: Implementation of the TimedTextPlayer class for handling timed text (subtitle) playback in Android's media framework, including message handling, seeking, reading, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: TimedTextPlayer
classes.description: Handles timed text (subtitle) playback, including starting, pausing, seeking, setting data source, and message processing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates playback by posting a seek message with a default position.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback by posting a pause message.

methods.name: seekToAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous seek to the specified time.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the source of timed text data.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for playback control, seeking, reading, and updating subtitles.

methods.name: doSeekAndRead
methods.description: Performs seek and read operations with specified timestamp.

methods.name: doRead
methods.description: Reads subtitle data from the source, handles blocking and errors, and posts subtitle events.

methods.name: postTextEvent
methods.description: Posts subtitle text events with timing adjustments.

methods.name: postTextEventDelayUs
methods.description: Posts subtitle events with specified delay.

methods.name: notifyListener
methods.description: Sends subtitle or clear events to the listener.
